📥 Download Pose Landmarker Model

Model Information

  • Model: Pose Landmarker (Float16)
  • Size: ~4MB (Lite version)
  • Format: MediaPipe .task file
  • Source: Google MediaPipe Models

Download Options

Option 1: Direct Download

Click the button below to download the model file:

📥 Download pose_landmarker.task

Option 2: Using cURL

curl -o public/assets/models/pose_landmarker.task \
  "https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker/float16/1/pose_landmarker.task"

Option 3: Using wget

wget -O public/assets/models/pose_landmarker.task \
  "https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker/float16/1/pose_landmarker.task"

Installation Steps

  1. Create the models directory: 
    mkdir -p public/assets/models
  2. Download the model using one of the methods above
  3. Verify the file exists: 
    ls -la public/assets/models/pose_landmarker.task
  4. The app will automatically use the local model if available
⚠️ Note: If you don't download the model, the app will use the CDN version by default. For production use, it's recommended to host the model locally for better reliability and privacy.

Alternative: Full Precision Model

For better accuracy (at the cost of larger size ~10MB):

📥 Download Full Precision Model

Use this by changing the model path in the configuration or passing it to initPoseLandmarker().

Using in the App

Once downloaded, update the initialization in your code:

// Use local model
await initPoseLandmarker('/assets/models/pose_landmarker.task');

// Or use default CDN
await initPoseLandmarker();

For more details, see the MediaPipe documentation.
